FIT.source: 128 exact K5B FIT original MemoryEnv physical outcomes from sizes 11/13; same real selected reward for R5 and matched conventional slot dict, no K5B CHECK/DEV used.
FIT.source_choice: Original K5B seeded uniform actual FIT terminal choice 0/1
FIT.require_source: Prior original same-source K5B physical FIT >=16 positives and >=16 negatives per size; verify all 128 authenticated actual source episodes.

new_cohorts.grouping: Four or eight independent real original MemoryEnv resets constitute one concurrent workgroup, at time of cue exposure all slot tasks pending; evaluate slots in exact reverse exposure order to ensure interference. Each policy sees only an opaque slot index and cue at first phase; later it sees same slot and top/bottom object identities but NO cue.
new_cohorts.original_episode_execution: Shared original physical public FullyObsWrapper goal-agnostic shortest-path navigator to neutral junction then physical chosen branch. Original env.step actual reward is the ONLY correctness label. Never read env.success_pos, failure_pos or actual goal correctness by hidden states.

main_gate: Across both original sizes and both capacity levels (4 and 8), R5 >=75% true goal success each, beat single-slot ablation by >=20 percentage points at capacity8 in each size, and trail matched conventional dict by no more than 1 goal in each cell. Exact two fresh Python OS process scientific outputs required.
novelty_veto: A tie with resource-matched Python dictionary is NOT evidence of novel native architecture or superiority. Even if bounded binding PASS, no scientific FSA first use.
holdout_rules: FIT frozen source prior to coding, CHECK and DEV distinct from K5B and K5A and disjoint from each other. Do not tune to CHECK/DEV outcomes. No policy updates during CHECK/DEV.
resources: All original physical action traces, per-method retrieval/update elapsed time, slot checkpoint byte size/hash, fit update events, whole process CPU peak RSS. No inferred power or training FLOPs.
